title: Religious Program Supervisor
raw_text:
Job Title                                                                                                                      Job Code
Religious Program Supervisor                                                                                                   001715
Job Family                                 NOC                Short Title (30 Characters)                      Short Title (14 Characters)
Office and Administrative Support          TBD                RELIGIOUS PROGRAM SUPERV                         RP SUP
Pay Plan                Career Field       Other Relationships and Rules
Enlisted                RP                 NEC AXXX series and other NECs as assigned.
Job Description
Religious Program Supervisors serve with Navy, Marine Corps, and Joint Services ashore and afloat; schedule and oversee Command Religious Program
(CRP) activities to support Spiritual Readiness (SR) and Professional Naval Chaplaincy (PNC); coordinate the provision and facilitation of Religious
Ministry (RM) and provide life-skills and resilience training; support the care of personnel and their families; advise chaplains and command leadership
on morale and the planning and execution of religious programs; conduct needs assessments; supervise CRP data collection; collect and analyze CRP data
to improve program delivery; manage administrative, financial, and supply functions for the CRP; initiate and coordinate routine contracting support; and
provide technical expertise on force protection requirements for Religious Ministry Teams (RMT) operating in expeditionary and combat environments.
May be assigned independent of a chaplain.

common_text: Religious Program Specialists (RP) serve with Navy, Marine Corps, and Joint Services ashore and afloat; operate in pluralistic environments while safeguarding religious freedom and implementing Professional Naval Chaplaincy (PNC); support chaplains by applying program management principles to plan, coordinate, and execute the Command Religious Program (CRP) strengthening Spiritual Readiness (SR); deliver resilience and life-skills training; perform administrative, financial, and contracting functions to enable effective ministry support; assess and advise leadership on effectiveness and responsiveness of Command Religious Program (CRP) to meet the needs of warfighters and their families; implement and support force protection measures for Religious Ministry Teams (RMT) operating in expeditionary and combat environments. __________________________________________ These Occupational Standards are to be incorporated as Volume I, Part B, of the Manual of Navy Enlisted Manpower and Personnel Classifications and Occupational Standards (NAVPERS 18068F) as Chapter 68.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
